en.title: The one-dimensional starting point
en.text:
Finite support; boundary u_0=0
Difference energy controls the weighted norm
en.readingText: Take finitely supported sequences with u_0=0. Difference energy controls a singularly weighted norm; higher-order versions are of Rellich type.

pages.readingText: 先看有限支撑序列，并令 u_0=0。差分能量控制带奇异权的函数大小；高阶版本称为 Rellich 型不等式。

en.title: Admissible lattice functions
en.readingText: Use finitely supported real functions vanishing at the origin. The singular weighted sum omits the origin. Keep the order fixed as dimension tends to infinity.

pages.readingText: 研究有限支撑实函数，原点处取零。右侧奇异权不在原点求和；阶数固定，而维数将趋于无穷。

pages.title: 离散梯度与 Laplace 算子

en.title: Discrete gradient and Laplacian
en.readingText: The vectors e_j are coordinate unit vectors. The discrete Laplacian uses the nonnegative sign convention; neighbour differences replace derivatives.

pages.readingText: 这里的 e_j 是坐标单位向量，离散 Laplace 算子采用非负符号约定。邻点差分代替连续导数。

en.readingText: Even orders iterate the Laplacian; odd orders add one gradient. This places first-order Hardy and second-order Rellich inequalities in one framework.

en.title: The optimal constant as an infimum
en.readingText: The optimal constant is the infimum of an energy quotient. Lower bounds must hold for every admissible function; upper bounds require a suitable test function.

pages.readingTex: \mathcal C_{m,d}=\inf_{0\ne u\in\mathcal E(\mathbb Z^d)}\frac{\sum_{n\in\mathbb Z^d}|\mathcal D^m u(n)|^2}{\sum_{n\ne0}|u(n)|^2/|n|^{2m}}
pages.readingText: 最佳常数是所有容许函数的能量比下确界。下界必须对全部函数成立；上界只需构造合适的试验函数。

en.title: Discrete and continuous dimension scales
en.readingText: Gupta (2023) identified the lattice growth order but not its leading coefficient. The high-dimensional scale itself differs from the continuous setting.

pages.title: 渐近首项的精确答案
pages.text:
固定 m；d→∞
首项系数：2^m

en.title: The precise leading coefficient
en.text:
Fix m; let d grow
Leading coefficient: 2^m
en.readingText: Fix the positive integer order m throughout. Matching upper and lower coefficients are required, beyond merely identifying the power of dimension.

pages.readingText: 始终先固定正整数阶数 m。证明需要给出相同首项的上下界，而不仅仅是与维数幂次同阶。

pages.title: Fourier 变换的目标空间

en.title: The Fourier target space
en.readingText: Lattice Fourier analysis moves the problem to a periodic torus. Zero mean removes the constant mode, and the difference symbol produces the weight ω.

pages.readingText: 格点 Fourier 分析把问题放到周期环面上。零均值去掉常数模态，而离散差分的频率符号产生权函数 ω。

pages.title: 加权范数的精确对应
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}a(0)=0,\quad a(n)=u(n)/|n|^{2m}\ (n\ne0)\\\Psi=(-i)^m\mathcal Fa,\quad\mathcal Fa=(2\pi)^{-d/2}\sum_n a(n)e^{-in\cdot x}\\\int_{\mathbb T^d}\Psi\,dx=0\\\sum_{n\ne0}\frac{|u(n)|^2}{|n|^{2m}}=\int_{\mathbb T^d}|D^m\Psi|^2\,dx\end{gathered}

en.title: Correspondence of the weighted norm
en.readingText: For each admissible lattice function there is a smooth zero-mean periodic Ψ. Here D denotes the continuous higher-order operator, distinct from its discrete counterpart.

pages.readingText: 对每个容许函数存在零均值光滑周期函数 Ψ。这里 D 表示连续高阶微分，须与前面离散算子区分。

blocks.tex: \begin{gathered}a(0)=0,\quad a(n)=u(n)/|n|^{2m}\ (n\ne0)\\\Psi=(-i)^m\mathcal Fa,\quad\mathcal Fa=(2\pi)^{-d/2}\sum_n a(n)e^{-in\cdot x}\\\int_{\mathbb T^d}\Psi\,dx=0\\\sum_{n\ne0}\frac{|u(n)|^2}{|n|^{2m}}=\int_{\mathbb T^d}|D^m\Psi|^2\,dx\end{gathered}

pages.title: 差分能量的精确对应
pages.text:
每阶差分产生因子 4
分子、分母同时核对

en.title: Correspondence of difference energy
en.text:
A factor 4 at each order
Check both numerator and denominator
en.readingText: Together with the previous identity this reduces lattice lower bounds to weighted torus estimates. The factor 4^m returns in the final conversion.

pages.readingText: 与上一板结合，格点上的下界化为环面上的加权微分估计。系数 4^m 会在最后换算回格点常数。

pages.title: 更一般的环面问题

en.title: A more general torus problem
en.readingText: All integrals are over the torus. Fix nonnegative k, ℓ and positive integer γ with 0<k−ℓ≤γ; test functions are periodic and have zero mean.

pages.readingText: 积分均在环面上。固定非负整数 k、ℓ 和正整数 γ，满足 0<k−ℓ≤γ；测试函数为零均值周期函数。

pages.title: 每增加一阶的代价
pages.text: 同权比较 + 逐阶降权

en.title: The cost of one additional order
en.readingText: For fixed order gap, each step contributes d/2 at leading order. Prove one-step estimates, iterate them, then match the resulting lower bound.

pages.readingText: 阶数差固定时，每增加一阶在首项上贡献 d/2。关键是先证明一阶跨越，再逐级迭代，并找到匹配的上界。

pages.title: 一阶加权恒等式
pages.text:
V≥0；周期分部积分
舍去完整平方

en.title: A first-order weighted identity
en.text:
V nonnegative; periodic integration
Drop the complete square
en.readingText: Let V and F be smooth. Expand the square and integrate by parts; periodicity cancels boundary terms. With nonnegative weight, dropping the square yields a lower bound.

pages.readingText: V 为光滑权，F 为光滑向量场。展开平方并在环面上分部积分；周期性使边界项抵消。取非负权时可舍去平方项得到下界。

pages.title: 二阶恒等式与 Hessian
pages.text:
Hessian 耦合必须控制
不能直接舍去

en.title: The Hessian in the second-order identity
en.text:
Control the Hessian coupling
It cannot simply be discarded
en.readingText: A Hessian term couples the weight to the gradient. It needs an estimate and cannot be discarded as if the weight were constant.

pages.readingText: 二阶情形额外出现权函数 Hessian 与梯度的耦合。这个项必须估计，不能像常系数情形那样直接忽略。

blocks.enText: The Hessian in the second-order identity

flowLabels.enText: The Hessian in the second-order identity

pages.title: 归一化权函数

en.title: The normalized weight
en.readingText: Direct differentiation expresses weight fluctuations with dimension decay. Here the continuous Laplacian is the usual sum of second derivatives.

pages.readingText: 这些直接微分计算把权函数的变化量写成带维数衰减的项。连续 Laplace 算子在这里采用通常的二阶导数之和。

pages.title: Hoeffding (1963) 集中估计

en.title: Hoeffding (1963) concentration
en.readingText: Coordinates are independent under uniform probability measure. The weight is an average of bounded variables, so deviations from one have exponentially small probability.

pages.readingText: 均匀概率测度下，各坐标独立。ρ 是有界随机变量的平均值，因此偏离 1 的区域概率随维数指数衰减。

pages.title: 熵把坏区域转成能量
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}W_0\ge0,\quad s>0,\quad B=\mathbb E_\mu(f^2)>0\\g=f^2/B,\quad h=e^{sW_0}/\mathbb E_\mu e^{sW_0}\\\mathbb E_\mu g=\mathbb E_\mu h=1,\quad\int g\log(g/h)d\mu\ge0\\\mathbb E_\mu(W_0f^2)\leq\frac{\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)}{s}+\frac{\log\mathbb E_\mu(e^{sW_0})}{s}\mathbb E_\mu(f^2)\end{gathered}
pages.text: 小概率 ≠ 任意函数的小贡献

en.title: Entropy converts concentration into energy
en.text: Small measure is not small energy
en.readingText: Take nonnegative continuous W_0 and s>0. Small probability alone cannot control arbitrary test functions; entropy records the cost of concentrating on a bad region.

pages.readingText: 取非负连续函数 W_0 和 s>0。单有小概率还不足以控制任意测试函数；熵不等式将函数集中在坏区域的代价显式记录下来。

boardLines.text: 小概率 ≠ 任意函数的小贡献
boardLines.enText: Small measure is not small energy

blocks.tex: \begin{gathered}W_0\ge0,\quad s>0,\quad B=\mathbb E_\mu(f^2)>0\\g=f^2/B,\quad h=e^{sW_0}/\mathbb E_\mu e^{sW_0}\\\mathbb E_\mu g=\mathbb E_\mu h=1,\quad\int g\log(g/h)d\mu\ge0\\\mathbb E_\mu(W_0f^2)\leq\frac{\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)}{s}+\frac{\log\mathbb E_\mu(e^{sW_0})}{s}\mathbb E_\mu(f^2)\end{gathered}

pages.title: 与维数无关的对数 Sobolev 估计
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)=\int f^2\log\frac{f^2}{\mathbb E_\mu(f^2)}\,d\mu\\\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)\leq C_{LS}\int|\nabla f|^2d\mu\\\mu=\mu_1^{\otimes d},\quad\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)\le\sum_{j=1}^d\mathbb E_{\widehat x_j}\operatorname{Ent}_{\mu_1}(f^2)\\\sum_{j=1}^d\int|\partial_j f|^2d\mu=\int|\nabla f|^2d\mu\end{gathered}

en.title: A dimension-independent logarithmic Sobolev bound
en.readingText: The key is that the constant does not grow with dimension. Combined with the previous estimate and exponential moments, this absorbs bad-region contributions into energy.

pages.readingText: 关键是常数不随维数增长。与前一板和指数矩估计结合，坏区域贡献能够吸收到主能量项中。

blocks.text: 与维数无关的对数 Sobolev 估计
blocks.tex: \begin{gathered}\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)=\int f^2\log\frac{f^2}{\mathbb E_\mu(f^2)}\,d\mu\\\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)\leq C_{LS}\int|\nabla f|^2d\mu\\\mu=\mu_1^{\otimes d},\quad\operatorname{Ent}_\mu(f^2)\le\sum_{j=1}^d\mathbb E_{\widehat x_j}\operatorname{Ent}_{\mu_1}(f^2)\\\sum_{j=1}^d\int|\partial_j f|^2d\mu=\int|\nabla f|^2d\mu\end{gathered}

en.title: The mean error after removing the weight
en.readingText: Concentration controls the typical region; small-ball volume handles negative powers near the origin. The new mean is a vanishing fraction, recovering a spectral gap close to one.

pages.readingTex: \begin{gathered}v=\rho^{\gamma/2}\varphi,\quad\int\varphi d\mu=0,\quad B=\int v^2d\mu\\|\mathbb E_\mu v|^2\le\delta_dB,\qquad\delta_d=\int(1-\rho^{-\gamma/2})^2d\mu\to0\\\mu(\rho\le r)\le(C_0r)^{d/2},\qquad d>2\gamma\\\int|\nabla v|^2d\mu\ge B-|\mathbb E_\mu v|^2\ge(1-\delta_d)B\end{gathered}

pages.title: 消去权与坏势的吸收
pages.tex: \begin{gathered}h=\rho^{\gamma/2},\quad v=h\varphi,\quad A=\int|\nabla v|^2d\mu,\quad B=\int v^2d\mu\\E=\int\rho^\gamma|\nabla\varphi|^2d\mu=A+\int\frac{\Delta h}{h}v^2d\mu\\\int Wv^2d\mu\le\frac{C_\gamma}{\sqrt d}(A+B),\quad A\ge(1-\delta_d)B\\E\ge(1-\varepsilon_d)A-\varepsilon_dB\ge(1-o_d(1))B\end{gathered}

en.title: Removing the weight and absorbing the bad potential
en.readingText: Fix a positive integer γ and take dimension sufficiently large. Concentration, entropy and log-Sobolev control the bad potential; the mean estimate supplies the spectral gap.

pages.readingTex: \begin{gathered}h=\rho^{\gamma/2},\quad v=h\varphi,\quad A=\int|\nabla v|^2d\mu,\quad B=\int v^2d\mu\\E=\int\rho^\gamma|\nabla\varphi|^2d\mu=A+\int\frac{\Delta h}{h}v^2d\mu\\W=\max\{-\Delta h/h,0\}\le C_\gamma[(\rho-1)_++d^{-1}]\\\int Wv^2d\mu\le\frac{C_\gamma}{\sqrt d}(A+B),\quad A\ge(1-\delta_d)B\\E\ge(1-\varepsilon_d)A-\varepsilon_dB\ge(1-o_d(1))B\end{gathered}
pages.readingText: 固定正整数 γ，维数充分大。集中、熵与对数 Sobolev 控制坏势；均值误差提供吸收所需的谱隙。

en.readingText: Require α≤0, α(α+γ−1)≥0 and d≥2(γ−1−α). For fixed γ, α=−√d satisfies these conditions in sufficiently large dimension.

pages.title: 一阶的两个基础估计

en.title: Two first-order estimates
en.readingText: The first keeps the weight power; the second lowers it by one and gains a dimension factor. Errors depend on fixed order parameters, not on the test function.

pages.readingText: 第一式保留权的次数，第二式降低一次权并获得维数因子。误差只依赖固定阶数参数，与测试函数无关。

pages.title: 二阶到一阶的基础估计

en.title: Second-order to first-order estimates
en.readingText: The second-order identity controls the Hessian error and gives the same weight-lowering cost. This pair lets both parity cases enter the iteration.

pages.readingText: 二阶加权恒等式控制 Hessian 误差，得到相同的降权代价。这一对估计使奇数阶与偶数阶都能进入迭代。

en.title: Uniform control of the Hessian coupling
en.text: Fix an integer γ≥1; bound the modulus
en.readingText: Fix an integer γ≥1. Bound the rank-one and diagonal terms separately. The diagonal term may be negative, so estimate the absolute value of the coupling.

pages.readingText: 固定整数 γ≥1。秩一项与对角项分别控制；对角项可以为负，所以估计整个耦合项的绝对值。

pages.title: 二阶降权的主项
pages.text: 先二阶同权，再吸收不降权项

en.title: The leading second-order weight-lowering term
en.readingText: First-order weight lowering gives the second-order same-weight estimate. Then absorb the same-weight term. The denominator is positive for fixed γ and sufficiently large dimension.

pages.readingText: 先用一阶降权建立二阶同权，再吸收不降权项。固定 γ、维数充分大时分母为正。

boardLines.text: 先二阶同权，再吸收不降权项

pages.title: 迭代得到环面下界

en.title: Iterating the torus lower bound
en.readingText: Choose the first- or second-order estimate according to parity. Each step lowers derivative order and weight power by one; finitely many errors still vanish.

pages.readingText: 根据当前阶数的奇偶，分别使用一阶或二阶基础估计。每次降低一阶和一次权；固定次数的乘积保持误差趋于零。

pages.title: 单一 Fourier 模态给出上界

en.title: A single Fourier mode matches the upper bound
en.readingText: Insert this zero-mean test function into the quotient. Derivatives alternate between sine and cosine; the common leading weighted integral matches the lower bound.

pages.readingText: 将这个零均值测试函数代入变分比。奇偶导数只在正弦与余弦之间交换，权积分的共同首项给出匹配的上界。

pages.title: 回到格点并完成夹逼

en.title: Returning to the lattice
en.readingText: Fourier correspondence gives the lower bound. For the upper bound, verify an admissible lattice preimage: a test function supported at two opposite unit sites completes the argument.

pages.readingText: 下界来自 Fourier 对应。上界还需检查所选环面函数确实来自容许格点函数：支撑在两个相反单位格点的试验函数完成这一步。
